rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Processing of Civil Complaints and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Processing of Civil Complaints and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 1-2 (Personnel placement for the protection of civil complaint processing personnel) The head of an administrative agency maypersonnel determined by the Minister of the Interior and Safety, taking into consideration the size of the civil complaint office, the number of visiting civil complaints, the frequency of illegal acts, etc., as safety personnel, etc., pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Civil Complaint Processing Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”).
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Personnel Placement for the Protection of Civil Complaint Processing Personnel) The head of an administrative agency may appoint personnel determined by the Minister of the Interior and Safety, taking into consideration the size of the civil complaint office, the number of visiting civil complaints, the frequency of illegal acts, etc., as safety personnel, etc., pursuant to Article 4(1), subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Processing of Civil Complaints (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”).

rows.source_ko: [This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 30, 2023]
rows.text_en: [This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 30, 2023]

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Marking of Civil Petition Documents) When the head of an administrative agencyreceives a civil petition document pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall affix the civil petition document marking seal specified in Annex 1 to the upper-left portion of said civil petition document . However , in the case of receipt as an electronic document, the civil petition document marking seal may be displayed in an electronic form. <Amended Mar. 30, 2023>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Marking of Civil Petition Documents) When the head of an administrative agency receives a civil petition document pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall affix the civil petition document marking seal specified in Annex 1 to the upper-left portion of said civil petition document . However , in the case of receipt as an electronic document, the civil petition document marking seal may be displayed in an electronic form. <Amended Mar. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Receipt of Civil Complaints) ①The civil complaint processing register pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 1. However, the receipt of civil complaints with a large volume of cases, such as family relationship registration, resident registration, military service, seals, and tax matters, may follow the form determined by the head of the relevant administrative agency.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Receipt of Civil Complaints) ① The civil complaint processing register pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Attached Form No. 1. However, the receipt of civil complaints with a large volume of cases, such as family relationship registration, resident registration, military service, seals, and tax matters, may follow the form determined by the head of the relevant administrative agency.

rows.source_ko: ② The receipt pursuant to Article 6 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is in the form of Annex 2 .
rows.text_en: ② The receipt pursuant to Article 6 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is in the form of Attached Form No. 2 .

rows.source_ko: ③ When a civil complaint office, a department in charge of receiving and sending documents, and a department in charge of processing civil complaints receive a civil complaint submitted by two or more complainants who have designated a representative, they shall issue a single receipt to the representative.
rows.text_en: ③ When a civil complaint office, a department in charge of receiving and sending documents, and a department in charge of processing civil complaints receive a civil complaint submitted by two or more complainants who have designated a representative, they shall issue a single receipt to the representative.

rows.source_ko: ④ Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, the head of an administrative agency may prepare and manage the form under Paragraph 1 using an electronic system when deemed necessary for the convenience of receiving civil complaints and efficient data management.
rows.text_en: ④ Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, the head of an administrative agency may prepare and manage the form under Paragraph 1 using an electronic system when deemed necessary for the convenience of receiving civil complaints and efficient data management.

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Power of Attorney) When the head of an administrative agency verifies whether a person authorized by a petitioner is indeed the one in accordance with Article 6, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall verify this using an identification document capable of verifying the identity and a power of attorney, etc. In this case, the power of attorney shall be in the form of Annex 3 .
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Power of Attorney) When the head of an administrative agency verifies whether a person authorized by a petitioner is indeed the one in accordance with Article 6, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall verify this using an identification document capable of verifying the identity and a power of attorney, etc. In this case, the power of attorney shall be in the form of Attached Form No. 3 .

rows.source_ko: Article 4-2 (Operation of Civil Service Offices) ① The head of an administrative agency (excluding local governments; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) may shorten, extend, or change the operating hours of a civil service office in accordance with Article 8-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree , taking into consideration the nature and form of receipt of civil complaints under their jurisdiction, the number of visiting civil complaints, etc., for the efficient receipt and processing of civil complaints and the protection of the rights of civil complainants.
rows.text_en: Article 4-2 (Operation of Civil Service Offices) ① The head of an administrative agency (excluding local governments; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) may shorten, extend, or change the operating hours of a civil service office in accordance with Article 8-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree , taking into consideration the nature and form of receipt of civil complaints under their jurisdiction, the number of visiting civil complaints, etc., for the efficient receipt and processing of civil complaints and the protection of the rights of civil complainants.

rows.source_ko: ② When the head of an administrative agency shortens, extends, or changes the operating hours of a civil service office pursuant to Paragraph 1, he/she shall post the operating hours on the administrative agency's internet homepage and around the civil service office, and shall provide necessary conveniences to minimize inconvenience to the public caused by the shortening, extension, or change of operating hours.
rows.text_en: ② When the head of an administrative agency shortens, extends, or changes the operating hours of a civil service office pursuant to Paragraph 1, he/she shall post the operating hours on the administrative agency's internet homepage and around the civil service office, and shall provide necessary conveniences to minimize inconvenience to the public caused by the shortening, extension, or change of operating hours.

rows.source_ko: ③ In cases where the head of an administrative agency establishes and operates a civil affairs office in a place other than the administrative agency pursuant to Article 8-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, he or she may operate it in a manner that processes only specific types of civil affairs, taking into consideration the location and purpose of the establishment.
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where the head of an administrative agency establishes and operates a civil affairs office in a place other than the administrative agency pursuant to Article 8-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, he or she may operate it in a manner that processes only specific types of civil affairs, taking into consideration the location and purpose of the establishment.

rows.source_ko: ④ Matters concerning the operating hours and operating methods of the civil complaint office pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be determined by the head of the administrative agency by directives, guidelines, notices, etc. ( in the case of an administrative agency pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 3, Items b and c of the Act, internal regulations).
rows.text_en: ④ Matters concerning the operating hours and operating methods of the civil complaint office pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be determined by the head of the administrative agency by directives, guidelines, notices, etc. ( in the case of an administrative agency pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 3, Items b and c of the Act, internal regulations).

rows.source_ko: 제5조(다른 행정기관 등을 이용한 민원의 접수ㆍ교부) ① 「민원 처리에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제14조제1항에 따라 다른 행정기관 등을 이용하여 접수ㆍ교부하는 민원 중 영 제12조제7항 전단에 따라 고시하여야 하는 민원의 신청은 별지 제4호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Receipt and Issuance of Civil Petitions Through Other Administrative Agencies, etc.) ① Applications for civil petitions received and issued through other administrative agencies, etc. under Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Processing of Civil Petitions (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) that are subject to public notification pursuant to the first sentence of Article 12, Paragraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using Attached Form No. 4.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제14조제1항에 따라 민원을 접수ㆍ교부하는 다른 행정기관 등의 장은 민원을 접수할 때 필요하다고 인정되는 경우에는 해당 민원인 본인 또는 그 위임을 받은 사람이 맞는지 확인할 수 있다. 이 경우 위임을 받은 사람이 맞는지 확인하는 방법에 관하여는 제4조를 준용한다. <신설 2023. 3. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The head of another administrative agency, etc., receiving or delivering a civil complaint pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act may verify whether the person is the petitioner themselves or a person authorized by them when receiving the complaint if deemed necessary. In such cases , Article 4 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the method of verifying the identity of the authorized person. <Newly added Mar. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제12조제2항에 따라 민원을 받은 소관 행정기관은 그 민원을 처리하면 별표 2의 처리인과 직인을 찍은 후 그 처리 결과를 팩스ㆍ인터넷 또는 전자적 시스템을 이용하여 민원인이 교부받으려는 다른 행정기관이나 농협 또는 새마을금고(이하 이 조에서 “교부기관”이라 한다)에 보내야 한다. 다만, 인터넷 또는 전자적 시스템을 이용하는 경우에는 별표 2의 처리인과 직인을 갈음하여 「행정업무의 효율적 운영에 관한 규정」 제3조제9호에 따른 전자이미지관인을 찍은 후 처리주무부서의 전화번호, 담당자의 이름 등을 표시하여 교부기관에 보낼 수 있다. <개정 2023. 3. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the competent administrative agency that has received a civil complaint shall, upon processing the complaint, affix the processing seal and official seal specified in Annex 2 and send the processing result to another administrative agency, Nonghyup, or Saemaul Geumgo (hereinafter referred to as the “issuing agency”) from which the complainant wishes to receive the document, using fax, the Internet, or an electronic system. However, in the case of using the Internet or an electronic system, an electronic image official seal pursuant to Article 3, Item 9 of the “Regulations on the Efficient Operation of Administrative Affairs” may be affixed in lieu of the processing seal and official seal specified in Annex 2 , and the document may be sent to the issuing agency indicating the telephone number of the department in charge of processing, the name of the person in charge, etc. <Amended Mar. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따라 처리 결과를 받은 교부기관은 별표 3의 처리인과 직인을 찍어 민원인에게 교부하여야 한다. <개정 2023. 3. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The issuing agency that has received the processing result pursuant to Paragraph 3 shall affix the processing seal specified in Annex 3 and the official seal, and issue it to the petitioner. <Amended Mar. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(처리기간 관련 서식) ① 영 제21조제2항에 따른 처리기간의 연장 통지 및 영 제40조제3항에 따른 거부처분에 대한 이의신청 결정기간의 연장 통지는 별지 제5호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Forms Related to Processing Period) ① The notice of extension of the processing period pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree and the notice of extension of the decision period for an objection to a refusal disposition pursuant to Article 40, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Attached Form No. 5 .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제23조제1항에 따른 처리진행상황 등의 통지는 별지 제6호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② Notification of the status of processing progress, etc. pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Attached Form No. 6 .

rows.source_ko: 제7조(처리상황의 확인ㆍ점검) 영 제22조에 따른 확인ㆍ점검은 매달 5일까지 지난 달의 민원처리상황에 대하여 실시한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Verification and Inspection of Processing Status) Verification and inspection pursuant to Article 22 of the Enforcement Decree shall be carried out on the status of civil complaint processing for the previous month by the 5th of each month.

rows.source_ko: 제8조(관계 기관ㆍ부서 간의 협조) ① 법 제20조제1항에 따라 관계 기관(민원사항과 관련된 단체ㆍ협회 등을 포함한다)ㆍ부서에 협조를 요청할 때에는 민원문서의 오른쪽 윗부분에 별표 4의 민원문서 표시인을 찍어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Cooperation between relevant agencies and departments) ① When requesting cooperation from relevant agencies (including organizations, associations, etc. related to the civil complaint) or departments pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the civil complaint document mark of Annex 4 must be stamped on the upper right corner of the civil complaint document.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 관계 기관ㆍ부서에 대한 협조 요청은 팩스ㆍ인터넷 또는 전자적 시스템으로도 할 수 있다. 이 경우 제1항에 따른 민원문서 표시인을 전자적 형태로 나타낼 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Requests for cooperation to relevant agencies or departments pursuant to Paragraph 1 may also be made via fax, the Internet, or an electronic system. In this case, the civil complaint document identifier pursuant to Paragraph 1 may be displayed in an electronic form.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(민원문서의 보완요구) ① 영 제24조에 따른 보완요구는 민원문서를 접수한 때부터 8근무시간 이내에 하여야 한다. 다만, 현지조사 등 정당한 사유로 8근무시간이 지난 후 보완하여야 할 사항이 발견된 경우에는 즉시 보완을 요구하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Request for Supplementation of Civil Petition Documents) ① A request for supplementation pursuant to Article 24 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made within 8 working hours from the time the civil petition document is received. However, if matters requiring supplementation are discovered after 8 working hours have passed due to justifiable reasons such as on-site investigation, a request for supplementation shall be made immediately.

rows.source_ko: ② 행정기관의 장은 다른 기관을 거쳐 접수된 민원문서 중 보완이 필요한 경우에는 해당 기관을 거치지 아니하고 민원인에게 직접 보완을 요구할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If a civil complaint document received through another agency requires supplementation, the head of the administrative agency may request the complainant to supplement it directly without going through the relevant agency.

rows.source_ko: 제10조(독촉장) 영 제28조제2항에 따른 독촉장은 별지 제7호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Notice of Demand) The notice of demand pursuant to Article 28 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Attached Form No. 7 .

rows.source_ko: 제11조(사전심사청구 관련 서식) ① 법 제30조제1항에 따른 사전심사의 청구는 별지 제8호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Forms for Requesting Preliminary Examination) ① A request for preliminary examination pursuant to Article 30 , Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with Attached Form No. 8 .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제30조제3항 본문에 따른 사전심사 결과 통지는 별지 제9호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The notification of the results of the preliminary examination pursuant to the main text of Article 30, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with Attached Form No. 9 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제34조제1항에 따른 사전심사청구 접수 처리부는 별지 제10호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The receipt processing register for a request for prior examination pursuant to Article 34 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Attached Form No. 10 .

rows.source_ko: 제11조의2(다수인관련민원 등에 관한 민원조정위원회의 심의) ① 행정기관의 장은 민원인의 권리보호 및 권익구제를 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 경우에는 영 제38조의2제1항에 따라 다수인관련민원과 법 제23조제1항에 따라 종결처리된 후 다시 접수된 민원(이하 “다수인관련민원등”이라 한다)에 관한 사항을 법 제34조에 따른 민원조정위원회(이하 “민원조정위원회”라 한다)의 심의에 부칠 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 11-2 (Deliberation by the Civil Complaint Mediation Committee on Civil Complaints, etc., Related to Multiple Persons) ① If the head of an administrative agency deems it necessary for the protection of rights and relief of interests of a complainant, he or she may, pursuant to Article 38-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, submit matters concerning civil complaints related to multiple persons and civil complaints received again after being closed under Article 23, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “civil complaints related to multiple persons, etc.”) to the deliberation of the Civil Complaint Mediation Committee under Article 34 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Civil Complaint Mediation Committee”).

rows.source_ko: ② 행정기관의 장은 민원조정위원회가 제1항에 따른 심의를 하기 전에 해당 연도에 접수된 다수인관련민원등의 추이(推移), 유형 및 처리현황 등을 분석하여 그 결과를 민원조정위원회에 제출할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of an administrative agency may analyze the trends, types, and processing status of multi-person complaints, etc. received in the relevant year before the Civil Complaint Mediation Committee conducts deliberation pursuant to Paragraph 1, and submit the results to the Civil Complaint Mediation Committee.

rows.source_ko: ③ 민원조정위원회는 제1항에 따른 심의사항이 없는 경우에는 다수인관련민원등에 관한 법 제34조제1항제1호의 사항을 심의해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If there are no matters for deliberation pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Civil Complaint Mediation Committee shall deliberate on the matters concerning civil complaints related to multiple persons, etc. specified in Article 34, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act.
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 30, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(이의신청 관련 서식) ① 법 제35조제1항 및 영 제40조제1항에 따른 이의신청은 별지 제11호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Forms for Objections) ① An objection pursuant to Article 35 , Paragraph 1 of the Act and Article 40, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Attached Form No. 11 .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제40조제4항에 따른 이의신청처리대장은 별지 제12호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The register of objection processing pursuant to Article 40, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Attached Form No. 12 .

rows.source_ko: 제13조(법정민원 신설 사전진단 결과의 통보 등) ① 중앙행정기관의 장은 영 제48조의3제2항에 따라 통보하는 경우 사전진단 대상 민원의 근거가 되는 법령안에 대한 입법예고 또는 훈령ㆍ예규ㆍ고시안에 대한 행정예고와 동시에 해야 한다. 다만, 「행정절차법」 제41조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 단서에 따라 입법예고를 하지 않는 경우 또는 같은 법 제46조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 단서에 따라 행정예고를 하지 않는 경우에는 지체 없이 통보해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Notification of Results of Preliminary Diagnosis for the Establishment of Statutory Civil Petitions, etc.) ① When the head of a central administrative agency provides notification pursuant to Article 48-3, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall do so simultaneously with the legislative notice regarding the draft statute ordinance serving as the basis for the civil petition subject to the preliminary diagnosis, or the administrative notice regarding the draft instruction, guideline, or notification. However, in cases where legislative notice is not provided pursuant to the proviso in the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 41, Paragraph 1 of the Administrative Procedure Act, or where administrative notice is not provided pursuant to the proviso in the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 46 , Paragraph 1 of the same Act, notification shall be provided without delay.

rows.source_ko: ② 행정안전부장관은 특별한 사정이 없으면 제1항의 통보를 받은 날부터 15일 이내에 해당 민원의 개선에 필요한 사항을 회신해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Unless there are special circumstances, the Minister of the Interior and Safety shall reply with matters necessary for the improvement of the relevant civil complaint within 15 days from the date of receiving the notification under Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 통보 및 제2항에 따른 회신에 관한 세부적인 사항은 행정안전부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Detailed matters concerning the notification pursuant to Paragraph 1 and the reply pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall be determined by the Minister of the Interior and Safety .
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 30, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <행정자치부령 제63호, 2016. 2. 12.>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs Decree No. 63, Feb. 12, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2016년 2월 12일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on February 12, 2016.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 개정) 국민제안규정 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Citizen Proposal Regulations is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제3조 중 “「민원사무처리에 관한 법률」에 따른 민원사항을 접수하였을 때에는 민원사무”를 “「민원 처리에 관한 법률」에 따른 민원을 접수하였을 때에는 민원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 3, “civil affairs when civil matters are received pursuant to the Act on the Processing of Civil Affairs” shall be changed to “civil complaint when a civil complaint is received pursuant to the Act on the Processing of Civil Complaints.”

rows.source_ko: 제3조(다른 법령과의 관계) 이 규칙 시행 당시 다른 법령에서 「민원사무 처리에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 또는 그 규정을 인용한 경우에 이 규칙 가운데 그에 해당하는 규정이 있으면 종전의 규정을 갈음하여 이 규칙 또는 이 규칙의 해당 규정을 인용한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Relationship with Other Laws and Regulations)  Where, at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, other laws and regulations refer to the "Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Processing of Civil Affairs" or its provisions, and there are corresponding provisions in this Rule, it shall be deemed that this Rule or the relevant provisions of this Rule have been referred to in place of the former provisions.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <행정안전부령 제121호, 2019. 6. 3.>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of the Interior and Safety Decree No. 121, June 3, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of the Interior and Safety Decree No. 390, Mar. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제1조의2 및 제4조의2의 개정규정은 2023년 4월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 1-2 and Article 4-2 shall enter into force on April 1, 2023.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(서식에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 따른 서식은 이 규칙 시행일부터 3개월 간 이 규칙에 따른 서식과 함께 사용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Forms)  Forms under the previous regulations at the time of enforcement of this Rule may be used together with the forms under this Rule for three months from the date of enforcement of this Rule.
